# Evidence records (generated by `scripts/validation_report.py` with the app's own code)

Code version 0.7.0. One row per object; the CSV next to this file has every field. Blind motion = catalogue-free search (no position or motion given); its uncertainty is approximated as rate / significance. Trajectory = straight-line fit to positions measured near the predicted track (catalogue-assisted). Verdicts (rules in `coldmovers/validation.py`): CONFIRMED only when the catalogue-free search sees the same motion in two or more trusted detectors with a combined significance of 5 or more; CANDIDATE when the evidence is weaker; INCONCLUSIVE when fewer than two detectors can be trusted; NOT DETECTED when trusted detectors show no motion. A temperature is INCONCLUSIVE on a red light.
